mapper.sql: select f.id, f.student_id, f.subject, f.total_hours, f.used_hours, f.total_amount, f.teacher_user_id, f.status, f.del_flag, f.remark, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.update_by, f.update_time, s.name as student_name, u.nick_name as teacher_name from cf_student_fee f left join cf_student s on s.id = f.student_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = f.teacher_user_id
mapper.select: where f.del_flag = '0' and f.status = '0' and f.student_id = #{studentId} order by f.create_time desc
mapper.insert:
insert into cf_student_fee
student_id, subject, total_hours, used_hours, total_amount, teacher_user_id, status, del_flag, remark, create_by, create_time,

mapper.update: update cf_student_fee set del_flag = '2' where id in #{id}
mapper.select: select id, fee_id, week_day, start_time, end_time from cf_student_fee_schedule where fee_id = #{feeId} order by week_day, start_time
mapper.insert:
insert into cf_student_fee_schedule (fee_id, week_day, start_time, end_time) values
(#{item.feeId}, #{item.weekDay}, #{item.startTime}, #{item.endTime})

insert into cf_student_fee_consume (fee_id, hours, source, checkin_id, consume_time, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{feeId}, #{hours}, #{source}, #{checkinId}, #{consumeTime}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
insert into cf_student_fee_refund (fee_id, hours, amount, refund_time, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{feeId}, #{hours}, #{amount}, #{refundTime}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update cf_student_fee set total_hours = total_hours - #{hours}, total_amount = total_amount - #{amount}, status = case when #{closeIfEmpty} and (total_hours - #{hours}) <= used_hours then '1' else status end, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0' and total_hours - #{hours} >= used_hours and total_amount >= #{amount}
mapper.select: select distinct u.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, u.nick_name as nickName, u.dept_id as deptId from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.del_flag = '0' and r.status = '0' where u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and r.role_key = 'teacher' and u.dept_id = #{deptId} order by u.nick_name
select u.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, u.nick_name as nickName, u.dept_id as deptId from sys_user u where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0'
select count(1) from sys_user_post up inner join sys_post p on p.post_id = up.post_id and p.status = '0' where up.user_id = #{userId} and p.post_code = #{postCode}
select distinct f.subject from cf_student_fee f where f.del_flag = '0' and f.status = '0' and f.teacher_user_id = #{teacherUserId} order by f.subject
mapper.sql: left join ( select fee_id, sum(hours) as refund_hours, sum(amount) as refund_amount from cf_student_fee_refund group by fee_id ) rh on rh.fee_id = f.id

select 'pay' as biz_type, f.create_time as biz_time, f.id as fee_id, s.name as student_name, f.subject as subject, u.nick_name as teacher_name, (f.total_hours + ifnull(rh.refund_hours, 0)) as hours, round( f.total_amount + ifnull(rh.refund_amount, 0) + f.used_hours * , 2) as amount, f.remark as remark, f.create_by as operator from cf_student_fee f left join cf_student s on s.id = f.student_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = f.teacher_user_id
where f.del_flag = '0'
union all
select 'consume' as biz_type, ifnull(c.consume_time, c.create_time) as biz_time, f.id as fee_id, s.name as student_name, f.subject as subject, u.nick_name as teacher_name, c.hours as hours, round(c.hours * , 2) as amount, c.remark as remark, c.create_by as operator from cf_student_fee_consume c inner join cf_student_fee f on f.id = c.fee_id and f.del_flag = '0' left join cf_student s on s.id = f.student_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = f.teacher_user_id
union all
select 'refund' as biz_type, ifnull(r.refund_time, r.create_time) as biz_time, f.id as fee_id, s.name as student_name, f.subject as subject, u.nick_name as teacher_name, r.hours as hours, r.amount as amount, r.remark as remark, r.create_by as operator from cf_student_fee_refund r inner join cf_student_fee f on f.id = r.fee_id and f.del_flag = '0' left join cf_student s on s.id = f.student_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = f.teacher_user_id
